```kotlin
import kotlin.math.atan2
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.sin

class DifferentialOdometry(
    private val countsPerInch: Double,
    startX: Double,
    startY: Double,
    private val startHeadingRadians: Double
) {
    init {
        require(countsPerInch.isFinite() && countsPerInch > 0.0)
        require(startX.isFinite() && startY.isFinite() && startHeadingRadians.isFinite())
    }
    private var initialRawYaw = 0.0
    private var previousLeft = 0
    private var previousRight = 0
    private var initialized = false
    private var x = startX
    private var y = startY

    fun update(leftTicks: Int, rightTicks: Int, headingRadians: Double) {
        require(headingRadians.isFinite())
        if (!initialized) {
            previousLeft = leftTicks
            previousRight = rightTicks
            initialRawYaw = headingRadians
            initialized = true // First call records encoder and yaw baselines.
            return
        }

        val left = (leftTicks - previousLeft) / countsPerInch
        val right = (rightTicks - previousRight) / countsPerInch
        previousLeft = leftTicks
        previousRight = rightTicks

        val forward = (left + right) / 2.0
        val fieldHeading = startHeadingRadians +
            atan2(sin(headingRadians - initialRawYaw), cos(headingRadians - initialRawYaw))
        x += forward * cos(fieldHeading)
        y += forward * sin(fieldHeading)
    }

    fun x() = x
    fun y() = y
}
```

```kotlin
import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.sin

class FusedOdometry(
    private val trackWidthInches: Double,
    startX: Double,
    startY: Double,
    private val startHeadingRadians: Double
) {
    init {
        require(trackWidthInches.isFinite() && trackWidthInches > 0.0)
        require(startX.isFinite() && startY.isFinite() && startHeadingRadians.isFinite())
    }
    private var initialRawYaw = 0.0
    private val encoderHeadingWeight = 0.10
    private var previousLeftTicks = 0
    private var previousRightTicks = 0
    private var started = false
    private var xInches = startX
    private var yInches = startY
    private var headingRadians = 0.0

    fun update(leftTicks: Int, rightTicks: Int,
               countsPerInch: Double, imuYawRadians: Double) {
        require(countsPerInch.isFinite() && countsPerInch > 0.0 && imuYawRadians.isFinite())
        if (!started) {
            previousLeftTicks = leftTicks
            previousRightTicks = rightTicks
            initialRawYaw = imuYawRadians
            headingRadians = startHeadingRadians
            started = true
            return
        }

        val leftInches = (leftTicks - previousLeftTicks) / countsPerInch
        val rightInches = (rightTicks - previousRightTicks) / countsPerInch
        previousLeftTicks = leftTicks
        previousRightTicks = rightTicks

        val forwardInches = (leftInches + rightInches) / 2.0
        val wheelTurn = (rightInches - leftInches) / trackWidthInches
        val predictedHeading = wrapRadians(headingRadians + wheelTurn)
        val fieldYaw = wrapRadians(startHeadingRadians + wrapRadians(imuYawRadians - initialRawYaw))
        val imuCorrection = wrapRadians(fieldYaw - predictedHeading)
        val correctedHeading = wrapRadians(
            predictedHeading + (1.0 - encoderHeadingWeight) * imuCorrection
        )

        // Use the middle of this small movement to rotate local travel into field axes.
        val middleHeading = headingRadians + 0.5 * wrapRadians(correctedHeading - headingRadians)
        xInches += forwardInches * cos(middleHeading)
        yInches += forwardInches * sin(middleHeading)
        headingRadians = correctedHeading
    }

    private fun wrapRadians(angle: Double): Double {
        require(angle.isFinite())
        return kotlin.math.atan2(sin(angle), cos(angle))
    }

    fun xInches() = xInches
    fun yInches() = yInches
    fun headingRadians() = headingRadians
}
```

```kotlin
private const val COUNTS_PER_INCH = 100.0 // Measure on your robot
private const val MAX_POWER = 0.25        // Start with a safe limit
private const val KP = 0.04               // Power per inch; tune slowly
private const val KV = 0.01               // Power per inch/second; tune slowly

// In runOpMode(), after START and a verified clear travel range:
val profile = TrapezoidProfile(8.0, 4.0, 8.0)
if (!opModeIsActive()) return
slide.mode = DcMotor.RunMode.RUN_WITHOUT_ENCODER
val startTicks = slide.currentPosition
val startTime = System.nanoTime()

try {
    while (opModeIsActive()) {
        val elapsed = (System.nanoTime() - startTime) / 1_000_000_000.0
        val target = profile.sample(elapsed)
        val measuredInches = (slide.currentPosition - startTicks) / COUNTS_PER_INCH
        val error = target.position - measuredInches

        // Forward-only example: overshoot requires a stopped recovery.
        val power = max(0.0, min(MAX_POWER, KP * error + KV * target.velocity))
        slide.power = power

        telemetry.addData("Target inches", "%.2f", target.position)
        telemetry.addData("Measured inches", "%.2f", measuredInches)
        telemetry.addData("Target speed", "%.2f in/s", target.velocity)
        telemetry.addData("Motor power", "%.2f", power)
        telemetry.update()

        if (elapsed >= profile.totalTime() && abs(error) < 0.25) break
        if (elapsed >= profile.totalTime() + 2.0) {
            telemetry.addLine("Move timed out; check encoder direction and tuning.")
            telemetry.update()
            break
        }
        idle()
    }
} finally {
    slide.power = 0.0
}
```

```kotlin
package org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode

import com.qualcomm.robotcore.eventloop.opmode.LinearOpMode
import com.qualcomm.robotcore.eventloop.opmode.TeleOp
import com.qualcomm.robotcore.hardware.DcMotor
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min

@TeleOp(name = "Guided PID Arm")
class GuidedPidArm : LinearOpMode() {
    companion object {
        // Configure direction first, then measure a positive counts/degree scale.
        private const val COUNTS_PER_DEGREE = 5.6
        private const val KP = 0.003
        private const val KI = 0.0
        private const val KD = 0.0
        private const val MAX_POWER = 0.25
    }

    private lateinit var arm: DcMotor
    private val pid = ArmPid(KP, KI, KD)

    override fun runOpMode() {
        arm = hardwareMap.get(DcMotor::class.java, "arm")
        arm.direction = com.qualcomm.robotcore.hardware.DcMotorSimple.Direction.FORWARD // Example: positive power must raise angle.
        arm.zeroPowerBehavior = DcMotor.ZeroPowerBehavior.BRAKE
        arm.mode = DcMotor.RunMode.STOP_AND_RESET_ENCODER
        arm.mode = DcMotor.RunMode.RUN_WITHOUT_ENCODER

        var targetAngle = 0.0
        telemetry.addLine("Check that the arm is at its zero reference.")
        telemetry.addLine("Press START only when the arm area is clear.")
        telemetry.update()
        waitForStart()
        pid.reset()

        try {
            while (opModeIsActive()) {
                if (gamepad1.dpad_down) targetAngle = 0.0
                if (gamepad1.dpad_left) targetAngle = 30.0
                if (gamepad1.dpad_up) targetAngle = 60.0
                if (gamepad1.b) break

                val currentAngle = arm.currentPosition / COUNTS_PER_DEGREE
                val output = pid.calculate(targetAngle, currentAngle)
                val power = max(-MAX_POWER, min(MAX_POWER, output))
                arm.power = power

                telemetry.addData("Target (deg)", "%.1f", targetAngle)
                telemetry.addData("Measured (deg)", "%.1f", currentAngle)
                telemetry.addData("Error (deg)", "%.1f", targetAngle - currentAngle)
                telemetry.addData("Motor power", "%.2f", power)
                telemetry.addLine("Press B to stop the test.")
                telemetry.update()
            }
        } finally {
            arm.power = 0.0
        }
    }

    private class ArmPid(private val kP: Double, private val kI: Double, private val kD: Double) {
        companion object { private const val MAX_INTEGRAL = 300.0 } // degree-seconds

        private var integral = 0.0
        private var previousAngle = 0.0
        private var previousTimeNanos = 0L

        fun calculate(targetAngle: Double, currentAngle: Double): Double {
            val now = System.nanoTime()
            val error = targetAngle - currentAngle

            if (previousTimeNanos == 0L) {
                previousTimeNanos = now
                previousAngle = currentAngle
                return kP * error
            }

            val dt = (now - previousTimeNanos) / 1_000_000_000.0
            previousTimeNanos = now
            if (dt <= 0.0 || dt > 0.1) {
                previousAngle = currentAngle
                return kP * error + kI * integral
            }

            integral += error * dt
            integral = max(-MAX_INTEGRAL, min(MAX_INTEGRAL, integral))
            val degreesPerSecond = (currentAngle - previousAngle) / dt
            previousAngle = currentAngle

            return kP * error + kI * integral - kD * degreesPerSecond
        }

        fun reset() {
            integral = 0.0
            previousAngle = 0.0
            previousTimeNanos = 0L
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode

import com.qualcomm.robotcore.eventloop.opmode.LinearOpMode
import com.qualcomm.robotcore.eventloop.opmode.TeleOp
import org.firstinspires.ftc.robotcore.external.hardware.camera.WebcamName
import org.firstinspires.ftc.vision.VisionPortal
import org.firstinspires.ftc.vision.opencv.ColorBlobLocatorProcessor
import org.firstinspires.ftc.vision.opencv.ColorSpace
import org.firstinspires.ftc.vision.opencv.ColorRange
import org.firstinspires.ftc.vision.opencv.ImageRegion
import org.opencv.core.Scalar
import org.opencv.core.RotatedRect

@TeleOp(name = "Guided Color Locator")
class GuidedColorLocator : LinearOpMode() {
    override fun runOpMode() {
        val locator = ColorBlobLocatorProcessor.Builder()
            .setTargetColorRange(ColorRange(ColorSpace.HSV,
                Scalar(15.0, 60.0, 70.0), Scalar(40.0, 255.0, 255.0)))
            .setRoi(ImageRegion.entireFrame())
            .setDrawContours(true)
            .build()

        val portal = VisionPortal.Builder()
            .setCamera(hardwareMap.get(WebcamName::class.java, "Webcam 1"))
            .addProcessor(locator)
            .build()

        telemetry.addLine("Open Camera Stream to check the preview.")
        telemetry.addLine("Press START to display blob measurements.")
        telemetry.update()
        waitForStart()

        while (opModeIsActive()) {
            val blobs = locator.getBlobs()
            ColorBlobLocatorProcessor.Util.filterByArea(50.0, 20000.0, blobs)
            ColorBlobLocatorProcessor.Util.sortByArea(
                com.qualcomm.robotcore.util.SortOrder.DESCENDING, blobs
            )

            if (blobs.isEmpty()) {
                telemetry.addLine("No matching blobs")
            } else {
                val largest = blobs[0]
                val box: RotatedRect = largest.getBoxFit()
                telemetry.addData("Center X (px)", "%.0f", box.center.x)
                telemetry.addData("Center Y (px)", "%.0f", box.center.y)
                telemetry.addData("Area (px)", "%d", largest.getContourArea())
            }
            telemetry.update()
            idle()
        }

        portal.close()
    }
}
```
